text:
Wall Street’s Top Analysts Upgrades , Downgrades & Initiations
$AAPL, $CVX, $FE, $FLEX, $INTC
Daily HeffX-LTN reviews Wall Street analysts research reports to find new investing and trading ideas for our readers. Some reports cover stocks to buy , and others cover stocks to sell or avoid.
Below is a list of Wall Street’s Top analysts outlook for Key issues for Tuesday, as follows:
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) analysts maintained as Equal Weight but the price target was cut to 157 from 168 at Barclays. The 52-wk trading range is 142.20 – 183.50.
Chevron Corp. (NYSE:CVX) was reiterated as Overweight and the price target was raised to 145 from 135 at Barclays. The 52-wk trading range is 102.55 – 133.88.
FirstEnergy Corp. (NYSE:FE) was raised to Outperform from Market Perform at Wells Fargo. The consensus target price is 36.46.
Flex Ltd. (NASDAQ:FLEX) analysts maintained as Buy but the price target was cut to 16 from 20 at Citigroup.
Intel Corp. (NASDAQ:INTC) was reiterated as Buy and the price target was raised to 64 from 60 at Citigroup. This was after multiple post-earnings analyst target hikes Friday.
Stay tuned…
Wall Street’s Top Analysts Upgrades, Downgrades & Initiations added by Paul Ebeling on May 1, 2018
